summary: This directory serves as a foundational shared layer for the application, providing cross-cutting utility functions, standardized data management, and core runtime services to ensure consistency across the codebase.
responsibilities: Providing reusable utility logic for data manipulation and formatting
Centralizing system configuration and runtime environment state
Managing file system interactions and path abstractions
Standardizing data transformation, encoding, and parsing processes
relationships: Shared utilities provide foundational logic that is consumed by core services for tasks like variable translation and parameter management.
Runtime and configuration services rely on standard utility libraries to maintain data integrity and type safety across the environment.
The standardization of data structures and transformation utilities ensures that disparate parts of the application share a common interface for processing information.
designDecisions: Centralization of cross-cutting concerns to eliminate code duplication
Use of service-based abstractions for complex infrastructure tasks like file system access and parameter retrieval
Focus on type safety and immutable state management for runtime and configuration data
Colocation of utility logic with its corresponding validation and testing logic
